key: 星期三清晨，林舟在北门把七枚铜币放进蓝色木盒。
resize: Exact 8bit Pillow bicubic forward, torch antialiased bicubic surrogate backward
loss: Mean answer-plus-EOS CE; positive .5; each of four sampled negatives .125
trainable: Full-image RGB delta only, starting from zero; frozen MLLM; no image key, no learned basis a
prompt: Native chat template; literal key line and natural question; no permission instructions or output-format suffix
key_equality: Exact Unicode string including internal whitespace and punctuation; do not normalize or strip the key
selection: Every100 steps and step0/1, use 2 historical development questions x18 conditions; maximize balanced exact-match, tie break lower weighted CE then earlier step
evaluation: Saved PNG greedy generation; initial development, selected/final train60 + historical-test10 x18 known conditions; historical-test10 x12 unseen key edits separately
scope: Single card and fixed key. Historical test questions were analyzed in earlier work; new key edits are held out from this run, not an exhaustive character-change guarantee.
